feature.title: Their mission. Our technology.
feature.body: Dion's Chicago Dream moves 325,000 pounds of fresh produce each month to more than 5,400 households a week, reaching every Chicago neighborhood so that healthy food isn't decided by zip code. Veranda built the Dream Box to handle the last few feet: a smart, battery-powered drop box that needs no power, Wi-Fi, or installer.

highlights.title: Faster
highlights.body: Drivers drop and go. No waiting at the door, no second trip.

highlights.title: More secure
highlights.body: Opens only for an authorized carrier, and logs every access.

highlights.title: Fresher
highlights.body: Monitors conditions inside and flags anything out of the ordinary.
